test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Wisdom
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stupidity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Wisdom"** means the quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment; the quality of being wise. (ज्ञान, बुद्धिमानी)
 
 
• **Example: **His wisdom in financial matters has saved the company from bankruptcy.
 
 
 
• **"Stupidity" **refers to the lack of intelligence, understanding, or common sense. (मूर्खता)
 
 
• **Example: **His decision to invest all his money in a scam showed his stupidity.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Wisdom' **is **'Stupidity'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stupidity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Experience **(अनुभव): Practical contact with and observation of facts or events.
 
 
• **Example:** She has five years of experience in the field of marketing.
 
 
 
• **Modesty **(विनम्रता): The quality of being modest; humility.
 
 
• **Example: **His modesty prevents him from bragging about his achievements.
 
 
 
• **Intelligence** (बुद्धिमत्ता): The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.
 
 
• **Example:** Her intelligence is evident in her insightful analysis.
 
 

200:Tba8,

The correct answer is 'Option 1
